_comment: Copy to profile/search.json and edit. boards are company names tried on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Personio, Recruitee and Workable. portals are job boards with an open feed (names are in job-portals.md); queries are the search terms sent to them, so keep personal details out. The three regexes are case-insensitive; portal locations end with the country name in English.
